CPRX.NessunAttore: Select a token or assign a character to your user.
CPRX.SolaLettura: You can only read this entry.
CPRX.ConfermaEliminaTesto: The entry leaves the Agent for good. Continue?
CPRX.ImpostazioneAvvisaNota: Show a notification when someone else edits an Agent you own.
CPRX.ImpostazionePosizioneNota: Where the button that opens the Agent appears.
CPRX.ImpostazioneTastoBarra: Also show in the token toolbar
CPRX.ImpostazioneTastoBarraNota: Puts the icon back in the left-hand token toolbar.
CPRX.ImpostazioneTemaNota: Colour scheme for the window. Applies to you only.
CPRX.BancaImportoNonValido: Enter a whole amount greater than zero.
CPRX.BancaNonApplicabile: Eddies not writable on that sheet, or not enough funds.
CPRX.SoloMaster: Only the GM can open the console.
CPRX.TavoloNota: The actors you always manage: they are the payment targets and who you reach with alerts. The NCPD records stay shared with everyone.
CPRX.NcpdCondivisoNota: There is one set of records for the whole world: anyone with the App reads it, you fill it in. Edit it from the NCPD App inside an Agent.
CPRX.IdentitaMancante: Give your line a name and a number, then you can write.
CPRX.NumeroGiaPreso: That number already belongs to a character.
CPRX.ScriviMessaggio: Write a message, Enter to send
CPRX.SalutoColNome: Call me by name instead of handle
CPRX.ImpostazioneScanlinesNota: The veil of scanlines over the glass and the light sweep crossing it. Applies to you only. The sweep stops by itself if your system asks for reduced motion.
CPRX.ImpostazioneAccentoNota: Six-digit hex code, e.g. #00d4a0. Leave empty to use the theme's own. Only the accent changes: background and text stay readable.
CPRX.EddiesNonTrovati: Eddies not found on the sheet
CPRX.ImpostazionePercorsoEddies: Path to eurodollars on the sheet
CPRX.ImpostazionePercorsoEddiesNota: Leave empty for automatic detection. If that fails, run game.modules.get('cprx-agent').api.diagnostica() in the console and enter the correct path here, without the system prefix.
CPRX.TroppiRisultati: Showing the first 80. Narrow the search.
CPRX.OggettoIntrovabile: Item not found in the compendium.
CPRX.EddiesNonScrivibili: Cannot write eurodollars back to the sheet.
CPRX.ConfermaAcquistoTesto: Buy {oggetto} for {prezzo} eb? You will have {residuo} eb left.
CPRX.ImpostazioneCompendiNota: Item compendium ids, comma separated. Leave empty to use them all.
CPRX.DescGladiator: Links two Agents for a virtual gladiator duel. The loser's Agent is destroyed, and an internal one takes the wearer's head with it.
CPRX.DescFortify: Built to find the weak spots in your home. Five minutes spent scanning a cover from within a metre earns an extra die of damage on the first attack against it.
CPRX.DescNcpd: Upload a photo and the app checks it against public police records: bounties, warrants, priors. Takes an hour and city network access. The police keep your photo and its metadata.
CPRX.DescMedscan: Puts you through to a remote specialist, for a fee. A hundred eurodollars buys an hour of first aid support, five hundred buys four hours covering surgery and medical tech.
CPRX.DescZiggurat: City guide: venues, gigs, services. Covers one city only, and grants an edge on local knowledge checks while you are there.
CPRX.NumeroSpento: This number is no longer live.
CPRX.NumeriEsauriti: No free numbers left on this prefix.
CPRX.NumeriAssegnati: Assigned {quanti} numbers. The list is in the console.
CPRX.RigeneraNumeroTesto: Take a new number. Anyone holding the old one loses you: past messages stay, but the thread starts over. Proceed?
CPRX.SetupNota: This Agent isn't anyone's yet. Five steps and it's yours: everything here can be changed later from settings.
CPRX.SetupIdentitaNota: The handle is your street name, the one that ends up on public boards. The real name stays on the device.
CPRX.SetupCasaNota: Housing and lifestyle are your fixed monthly cost. Change them any time from the House app.
CPRX.SetupDispositivoNota: An internal Agent is implanted: it can't be left in a room and a Breacher can't reach it. Tracking tells whoever is listening where you are.
CPRX.RipristinaNota: Takes the Agent back to first boot. Wipes identity, contacts, notes, gigs, archive and bank log. Leaves eurodollars, reputation and purchased apps alone.
CPRX.RipristinaConferma: Reset the device? Contacts, notes, gigs, messages and the bank log are wiped and cannot be recovered. Purchased apps stay.
CPRX.NessunaConversazione: No conversations. Dial a number to start one.
CPRX.AgentDistruttoTesto: The processor is fried. No network, no apps, no contacts until you fit a new one.
CPRX.SostituisciAgentTesto: A new Agent costs {prezzo} eb. The apps you own reinstall themselves. You are left with {residuo} eb. Proceed?
CPRX.SfidanteSparito: Whoever challenged you no longer exists.
CPRX.AvvisoAgentInterno: Your Agent is implanted: losing the duel also costs you a concussion.
CPRX.EsitoCommozione: {nome} was wearing an internal Agent: critical injury {ferita} applied.
CPRX.EsitoCommozioneAMano: {nome} was wearing an internal Agent: the concussion has to be noted by hand, it is not in the compendia.
CPRX.FortifyEsempio: The low wall by the door
CPRX.FortifyScansione: Scan of {bersaglio} complete. The first attack against that cover gets an extra damage die. {minuti} minutes have to be spent.
CPRX.FortifyScansioneTempo: Scan of {bersaglio} complete after {minuti} minutes. The first attack against that cover gets an extra damage die.
CPRX.MedscanPerNota: Blank for yourself, or someone else's number
CPRX.ZigguratTiro: Local knowledge of {citta}: {totale} (1d10 = {dado}, modifier {modificatore}, {bonus} of it from the guide).
CPRX.ImpostazionePrefissoNota: The leading digits of every Agent number. Changing it leaves numbers already handed out alone.
CPRX.ImpostazionePrezzoAgentNota: What it costs a player to replace an Agent destroyed in a duel. The GM restores one for free.
CPRX.ImpostazioneAvanzaTempoNota: A 4Tify scan or an NCPD reply moves world time forward. Only a GM can do it.
CPRX.ImpostazioneSuoniNota: Plays an alert when something lands on your Agent.
CPRX.ImpostazioneApriSuChiamata: Open the Agent when it rings
CPRX.ImpostazioneApriSuChiamataNota: The window opens by itself when someone calls an Agent you own.
CPRX.NumeroNascostoNota: The number is hidden per contact: open the entry in your contacts and tick the box. Whoever gets it reads ??? instead of a name, never sees the number and cannot save it to their contacts, but can still reply and call back.
CPRX.ConversazioneCoperta: The sender is withholding their number.
CPRX.ContattoCoperto: This number is withheld: it cannot be saved to your contacts.
CPRX.ImpostazioneGmCopertiNota: On, a GM reads the name and number of withheld threads too. Off — the default — a hidden number stays ??? for everyone, GM included. The mail is still delivered either way: this only changes what the Agent shows.
CPRX.NcpdSchedarioVuoto: Empty records. Whoever is not on file does not come up.
CPRX.ImpostazioneLimiteFiloNota: How many messages and calls stay on each Agent sheet. Past this number the oldest entries drop off.
CPRX.CampoNascondiNumero: Hide my number from this contact
CPRX.CancellaChatTesto: The conversation leaves your Agent for good. It stays on the other one. Continue?
CPRX.MedscanUsiPronto: +1 to First Aid and Paramedic checks to Stabilize a patient or perform Quick Treatment.
CPRX.MedscanUsiChirurgia: +1 to Surgery or Medical Tech checks: long enough for a treatment, an installation, a biosculpt or surgery.
CPRX.MedscanAbbonato: Trauma Team Executive subscription active: consults are free. Abusing it may cost you the subscription.
CPRX.ZigguratDbVuoto: This city has no entries yet. The GM fills it in.
CPRX.GladiatoreMancante: Link your gladiator sheet before entering the arena.
CPRX.ArenaAvviso: A ranked duel is to the death: the loser's Agent is completely destroyed, and an internal one also takes the Concussion critical injury.
CPRX.ArenaTempoScaduto: After {round} rounds neither falls: the healthier one wins.
CPRX.ImpostazioneDannoArena: Damage per hit in the arena
CPRX.ImpostazioneDannoArenaNota: Damage formula for each hit landed in Digital Gladiator duels, e.g. 2d6. It is not the gladiator's real weapon: it is how the fight is tuned.
CPRX.ArenaConsoleNota: Who has a gladiator linked and how they are doing. From here you can bring a destroyed Agent back without charging anything.
CPRX.SenzaAgent: {nome} has no Agent in their inventory.
CPRX.ImpostazioneRichiediOggettoNota: On, the button that opens the Agent only shows for characters carrying an item called "Agent". Off, anyone can open it. The GM is never restricted.
CPRX.StatiNota: What is switched on for the characters at your table. None of these expires reliably on its own: a MedScan consult only ends if world time advances, a 4Tify mark stays until the die is spent, and a Ziggurat city never expires.
CPRX.StatiDadoInPiu: bonus damage die not yet spent
CPRX.CasaCorporativo: You are a Corporate: the company pays for housing and food. For as long as you keep the job.
CPRX.CasaInMora: You are behind on rent. What happens to people who do not pay, in Night City, is up to your landlord.
CPRX.CasaNota: Rent comes due with the calendar, and the GM can collect it by hand. Here you pay it yourself: needed with the automatic month off, or to clear an arrear.
CPRX.Qg_riduzione_Nota: Living at the HQ cuts a third off the rent.
CPRX.Qg_infermeria_Nota: You heal as though your BODY were two points higher.
CPRX.Qg_salotto_Nota: Common space for the crew between jobs.
CPRX.Qg_orto_Nota: Fresh vegetables: a fifth off the Lifestyle cost.
CPRX.CasaRiscuotiTesto: Charge rent and food for the month to everyone on the roster. Anyone short does not go below zero: they get an overdue month instead. Continue?
CPRX.StatiFissoNota: The city guide is not a timed buff: it is the App they bought, and it is not switched off from here.
CPRX.ImmagineNonDisponibile: The file picker is not available in this version of Foundry.
CPRX.ImpostazioneCorpGratisNota: On, anyone with the Corporate role on their sheet gets a corporate conapt and company-paid food, and is never charged. Off, they pay like everyone else.
CPRX.DescReputazione: Night City's rumour net. It does not tell you what you are worth: it tells you what is said about you, and how far your name travels. The number is the real one from your sheet, and so is the ledger — StreetWire keeps no copy, it reads.
CPRX.RepPortataAperta: Your name travels on its own: nobody needs to know you to know who you are.
CPRX.RepPortataChiusa: Outside your own circle nobody has heard of you yet.
CPRX.RepRegistroNota: This is your sheet's own ledger, not a copy: what you see here the GM sees too, and the other way round.
CPRX.RepRegistroVuoto: Nobody is talking about you yet.
CPRX.RepNonLetta: Reputation cannot be read on this sheet.
CPRX.RepConsoleNota: Write the reason: it goes into the sheet's ledger alongside the number, and in six months it is the only thing that will say why.
CPRX.RepMotivoEsempio: Faced down a Maelstrom Solo, in front of everyone.
CPRX.RepNonScrivibile: Reputation cannot be written on this sheet.
CPRX.ImpostazioneRepPubblica: Reputation at which a name travels on its own
CPRX.ImpostazioneRepPubblicaNota: From this value up a character is known well enough to be recognised without introductions. The level table is the one from the book; this threshold is the table's call. Defaults to 5, that is "known across the city".
CPRX.DtNotaEsempio: Where, with whom, what you are trying to get.
CPRX.DtNienteDichiarato: You have not said what you do with this week yet.
CPRX.DtEsitoEsempio: How it went. Only the character who declared reads this.
CPRX.TempoImpostaNota: Type where you want to be and go there, forward or back. Nothing fires: no rent, no notices — moving the setting is not time played. This is how you pick the campaign year: 2045, 2074, whatever you want.
CPRX.TempoIndietroTesto: You are winding the world clock back. What already happened stays happened — rent paid, weeks closed — and moving forward again charges the month a second time. Proceed?
CPRX.TempoSoloAvanti: Forward only: rent already paid is not refunded, and winding the clock back would charge it twice.
CPRX.TempoRubricaVuota: The table roster is empty: rent charges nobody and notices reach nobody. Add the characters from the Table tab.
CPRX.ImpostazioneDataZeroNota: The date world time zero falls on, as YYYY-MM-DD. Every other date the calendar shows is derived from it. Defaults to 2045-01-01, the year Cyberpunk RED starts.
CPRX.ImpostazioneMesiAutoNota: On, whenever world time crosses the first of the month rent is charged automatically to everyone on the roster. Off, only the console button starts a month. The button stays either way.
CPRX.GruppoPrimoMessaggio: The first line of the group
CPRX.GruppoRubricaVuota: Nobody in your contacts: type the numbers by hand.
CPRX.GruppoPochiMembri: A group needs at least two people besides you.
CPRX.GruppoSenzaTesto: A group starts with its first line: write it.
CPRX.GruppoNienteCoperti: You withhold your number from some of them: inside a group it would show, so they cannot be added.
CPRX.GruppoEsciTesto: From now on you stop receiving this group. What already arrived stays.
CPRX.PostaInBloccoNota: "To each" sends the same line in separate threads: nobody knows about the others. "To the group" opens one thread where everyone sees everyone and replies to all.
CPRX.CasaCanoneAMano: Rent does not fire on its own: the GM collects it.
CPRX.CasaTabelleNota: Core-book rows can be repriced, and your own go below. They apply to the whole table.
CPRX.TempoCanoneAutoAcceso: Rent follows the calendar, on the first of the month.
CPRX.TempoCanoneAutoSpento: Rent does not fire on its own: you collect it, with the button above.
CPRX.NessunPreferito: No favourites. Open a contact and star it.
CPRX.ChiamataNessunInvitato: You have not picked anyone to add.
CPRX.DescAlex: Ziggurat's netcrawler. Searches the table's Urban Database and rolls Library Search with the Agent's bonus.
CPRX.DescZpost: Ziggurat's mail. Subject and long text, with an archive of what you received and sent.
CPRX.DescGarden: The local Data Pool: the table's board. Anyone with the App reads, posts and hearts.
CPRX.DescBangme: Eurobank transfers between two Agents. Preset amounts and contacts from your address book.
CPRX.DescHustool: Half-hour side jobs for ten eurodollars. On a 1 it goes wrong, on a 10 it ends in trouble.
CPRX.DescRoach: The glitched horse platformer. Play it, keep the record, needle the rest of the table.
CPRX.DescWatchbox: Leave the Agent in the middle of a room and it watches it. Does not work with an internal Agent.
CPRX.DescBrainwasher: An hour a day for a week before therapy. Then 1d10 decides whether it takes a day less or a day more.
CPRX.DescElflines: Your Elflines Online account: elf STATs, guild and server.
CPRX.DescBigIaaa: Raises the Agent's Library Search bonus from +2 to +3. And sends your data to Ziggurat.
CPRX.AlexDbVuoto: The table's Urban Database is empty: there is nothing to search until the GM fills it in.
CPRX.AlexTiro: Library Search on “{cerca}”: {totale} ({dado} + {modificatore}, of which +{bonus} from the Agent).
CPRX.GardenScrivi: What's going on in Night City?
CPRX.GardenVuoto: The Patch is empty. Write something.
CPRX.HusEsitoMale: Customer gone, place closed: {minuti} minutes wasted and nothing in your pocket.
CPRX.HusEsitoGuai: Job done in {minuti} minutes: +{paga} eb, but roll on the encounter table.
CPRX.WatchDaPosare: Agent to place in the middle
CPRX.WatchEsempio: Back of the bar, first floor...
CPRX.WatchInterno: WatchBox does not work with an internal Agent: the Agent has to be left in the middle of the room.
CPRX.WatchAvviata: WatchBox is watching “{stanza}”, up to {lato}×{lato} m. Beaten with a Stealth check DV {vd}.
CPRX.BwUnOraAlGiorno: At least an hour a day before therapy
CPRX.BwEsitoPrima: 1d10: {dado}, even. Therapy takes one day less.
CPRX.BwEsitoDopo: 1d10: {dado}, odd. The app's blocks add a day to the therapy.
CPRX.BwNotaPrima: Last cycle: one day less of therapy.
CPRX.BwNotaDopo: Last cycle: one day more of therapy.
CPRX.IaaaArchivistica: The bonus the Agent gives to Library Search checks
CPRX.IaaaTelemetria: Usage data streamed to Ziggurat, continuously. Cannot be turned off.
CPRX.StatiWatch: Beaten with a Stealth check DV {vd}.
CPRX.DescSentinel: The Agent's defence: how hard it is to hack, what of yours talks outward, and the reboot that throws everyone off.
CPRX.DescPatchpro: The studio behind your Patch: drafts, published posts, hearts received and a couple of numbers on how it is going.
CPRX.DescCorp: The employee portal of the Corporation you work for: badge, the areas it opens, company notice board and contract benefits.
CPRX.CorpIncarichiVuoti: No gigs with this client. These are the gigs from your Gigs app: just write the company name as the client.
CPRX.CorpTracciato: Every action taken with this badge is logged and tied to your employee profile.
CPRX.CorpArchivioVuoto: Nothing on file. What you write here is what employees read in the app.
CPRX.CorpSenzaBadgeNota: You are not on record as an employee of any Corporation.
CPRX.CorpAssegnaDaConsole: Badges are assigned from the GM console, Corp Link tab.
CPRX.CorpBadgeVuoto: Nobody at the table has activated a badge.
CPRX.CorpBenefitMedicaNota: Trauma Team subscription paid by the company.
CPRX.CorpBenefitMensaNota: Discounted food and drink, alcohol excluded.
CPRX.CorpBenefitBuonuscitaNota: Accrues at the higher badge grades.
CPRX.Corp_arasaka_Note: Since the war its troops are quietly leased to other companies. Three internal factions fight over the top: Kiji, Taka and Hato.
CPRX.Corp_militech_Uffici: Rome, Zurich, Night City, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Beijing
CPRX.Corp_militech_Note: Nationalised after the 4th Corporate War, then returned to private hands. Public face: General Samantha "Sammy" Lee Young.
CPRX.Corp_biotechnica_Uffici: London, Bonn, Paris, Dallas, Night City, Sydney, Rio
CPRX.Corp_biotechnica_Note: Inventor of CHOOH², and the closest thing to a "good" Corporation. Works on bringing back extinct species and habitats.
CPRX.Corp_traumateam_Uffici: Nearly every major North American city
CPRX.Corp_traumateam_Note: 1,350 AV-4s, 30 corporate jets, 22 Osprey II aircraft and 4 C-29 cargo planes. Stayed neutral through the War.
CPRX.Corp_petrochem_Uffici: Night City, Washington D.C., Miami, Chicago, Tokyo, London, Paris, Rome
CPRX.Corp_petrochem_Note: The world's largest licensed producer of CHOOH². Controls millions of acres of farmland across the United States.
CPRX.Corp_sovoil_Uffici: Tashkent, Saint Petersburg, Tokyo, Seoul, Beijing, Manila, Havana, Night City
CPRX.Corp_sovoil_Note: Holds economic dominance over oil. Public face: Anatoly Novaragov. Petrochem's long-standing rival.
CPRX.Corp_continental_Settore: Organic and synthetic food and drink
CPRX.Corp_continental_Uffici: Chicago, Atlanta, Baltimore, Seattle, Dallas, Night City
CPRX.Corp_continental_Note: Monopoly on CHOOH² production. Runs the Oasis Community Loyalty Program, which rations food and goods.
CPRX.Corp_dangergal_Uffici: New York, Miami, Montreal, London, Rome, Zurich, Washington D.C., Los Angeles, Toronto
CPRX.Corp_dangergal_Note: Investigation agency for delicate cases. Its director was born an Arasaka, and dismantles Arasaka operations in Night City.
CPRX.Corp_rocklin_Uffici: Washington D.C., Chicago, Denver, Atlanta, Baltimore, Seattle, Dallas, Night City
CPRX.Corp_rocklin_Note: Cheap cyberware for the mass market. At the centre of the AI Protocols and "cybernetic gestalt" controversy.
CPRX.Corp_network54_Uffici: Atlanta, Chicago, New Orleans, Dallas, Denver, Arizona, Portland, Seattle, Los Angeles, San Francisco
CPRX.Corp_network54_Note: Signal monopolist: it broadcasts on the same frequency nationwide. Known shows include Cooking with Kibble and The Elflines Online! Chronicles.
CPRX.SentVdDiretto: Hack with the Agent in hand
CPRX.SentRiavvioNota: Five minutes. The Breacher drops and every installed command is wiped. You do not get to know who it was.
CPRX.SentRiavviato: System rebooted: {minuti} minutes, Breacher dropped, installed commands wiped.
CPRX.SentTiro: Counter-scan — Electronics and Security Tech: {totale} ({dado} + {modificatore}). Compare it with the hacker's roll.
CPRX.NodoInterno: Internal: a Breacher cannot reach it
CPRX.NodoVd: A Breacher at 20 m opens it at DV {vd}
CPRX.BancaRichiestaNota: A request moves no money: it sends a message, and whoever gets it decides.
